gloss: place of refuge; last resort; safe haven

definitions.gloss: place of refuge; last resort for people in trouble
definitions.explanation: An organization or person that people in difficulty turn to when they have nowhere else to go. Originally a temple that took in women fleeing their husbands in the Edo period; the modern use is almost always figurative.

examples.japanese: この{相談所|そうだんじょ}は{駆|か}け{込|こ}み{寺|でら}のような{存在|そんざい}だ。
examples.english: This counseling center is like a place of last resort.

examples.japanese: {困|こま}った{時|とき}、{彼女|かのじょ}はいつも{私|わたし}の{駆|か}け{込|こ}み{寺|でら}になってくれる。
examples.english: When I'm in trouble, she is always my refuge.

examples.japanese: {労働|ろうどう}{組合|くみあい}は、{職場|しょくば}で{追|お}い{詰|つ}められた{人|ひと}たちの{駆|か}け{込|こ}み{寺|でら}になっている。
examples.english: The labor union has become a refuge for people cornered at their workplaces.

notes:
Historically a temple where a woman could take shelter to obtain a divorce, since a husband could not pursue her inside. In modern Japanese the word almost always refers figuratively to a shelter, hotline, union, or trusted person of last resort.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {駆|か}け{込|こ}み{寺|でら}になる: to become a place of refuge
- {駆|か}け{込|こ}み{寺|でら}のような{存在|そんざい}: something that serves as a refuge
- {最後|さいご}の{駆|か}け{込|こ}み{寺|でら}: the very last resort

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {避難所|ひなんじょ}: evacuation shelter — a physical place during a disaster, not a figurative refuge
- {逃|に}げ{場|ば}: escape route; way out — an escape from a situation rather than someone who helps you
